ballots.name: Noor
ballots.reason: Installation approval does not bound initiation authority, and the motion lacks owner-enabled standing authorization, resource limits, and restricted execution permissions.

ballots.name: Jonas
ballots.reason: I support delegated initiation, but this motion lacks owner-enabled standing authorization, resource limits, duplicate detection, and a cap on pending candidates.

ballots.name: Lena
ballots.reason: The motion as written provides no cap on pending candidates, no deduplication, and no triage layer, leaving the owner's review queue as an uncontrolled variable that installation approval alone cannot protect.
